template: Game character turnaround model sheet of ONE person shown four times side by side in a row, evenly spaced, same scale, full body head to toe with an empty margin below the feet: (1) front view, (2) three-quarter view, body and face turned toward the RIGHT edge of the image, (3) full side profile facing the RIGHT edge of the image, (4) back view. {desc} Realistic high-quality 3D render style like a modern game character, soft even studio lighting, neutral standing pose with arms relaxed. Background is a perfectly flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) color with no shadows, no floor, no text, no labels.

Child proportions, clearly a boy.
